workarounds.symptom: Spawn refused with the parent agent named when an unrelated project agent spec does not parse
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(subagent): name the unreadable spec files when a spawn is refused fail-closed. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/messaging.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/messaging_api/spawn.py, src/kiro_crew/subagent.py. `parent_spawn_allowlists` answers `None` when no readable spec declares the parent agent's name and some spec file in the agents directory cannot be read. `_vet_parent_available_agents` then refuses the spawn. The refusal names only the parent agent, for example "the parent agent 'kirocrew' spec could not... (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/31462)

workarounds.symptom: deploy_artifact never offers the human override for a scan block, and drops refusal hints
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deploy): let deploy_artifact read the route's scan block and hints. Target files: src/kiro_crew/mcp_core_parts/gateway.py, src/kiro_crew/mcp_tools/artifacts.py, test/conftest.py. **Goal:** When a deploy is refused, the `deploy_artifact` tool tells the agent what actually happened: a scan block it can hand to a person to override, a hard block with its reason, or a refusal with its retry hint and command. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/34648)

workarounds.symptom: Cron-born chat tabs vanish on every gateway restart: restore reads dashboard_cron-<id>.jsonl, a name never written
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): restore cron chat tabs by their written transcript name. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_utils.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_utils_slots.py, test/test_cron_slot_restore_name.py. **Goal:** Keep cron-born chat tabs in the sidebar across a gateway restart instead of silently dropping them. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/31309)
